US Approves $5 Billion Arms Sale to Saudi Arabia

The United States has approved a potential sale of bombs and other equipment to Saudi Arabia valued at approximately $5 billion. The package includes Joint Direct Attack Munitions (JDAM) kits and bombs. This approval comes amid ongoing conflict in the region, with Saudi Arabia facing drone and missile attacks. The sale aims to bolster Saudi Arabia's capabilities in the Gulf.
